---
name: New skill request
about: Propose a new skill for the pack
labels: enhancement, skill-proposal
---

## Skill name
Proposed slug (lowercase, hyphenated). Example: `pharmacokinetics-modeling`.

## One-paragraph summary
What problem does this skill solve? Who would invoke it?

## Scope fit
This pack focuses on biomedical research. Briefly explain how this skill fits:
- [ ] Reporting guideline (e.g., CONSORT, REMARK, STARD)
- [ ] Funding body / grant template
- [ ] Clinical sub-specialty workflow
- [ ] Senior scientific engineering practice
- [ ] Regulatory framework
- [ ] Other (explain)

## Proposed workflow outline
List the phases or steps the skill would guide the agent through (3-7 bullet points).

## Reference material
Standards, guidelines, papers, or canonical implementations this skill should align with.

## Existing alternative?
Is there a skill in this pack (or in [`addyosmani/agent-skills`](https://github.com/addyosmani/agent-skills) or [`K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills`](https://github.com/K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills)) that already covers part of this? If so, what's the gap?

## Would you contribute it?
- [ ] Yes, I'd like to write this skill myself.
- [ ] No, I'm proposing it for someone else to write.
- [ ] Maybe, depending on guidance.
